failure_modes: Losing the ability to judge output
gloss: Delegate with a self-contained brief and a checked goal, knowing leverage costs feel
invariants: Brief written for someone with no context
mechanism: Delegation begins with a validated goal, since {{misspec}} makes fluent execution worthless. The delegator writes a {{brief}} and accepts the loss described in {{leverage}}: more reach, less tactile contact. Direct hands-on work is retained where feel matters, since the handle alone does not show what is moving.
